name: Sundarkand Path
description: Group devotional — home or temple. The full Sundarkand sung end to end by a live mandali, with the household joining the chaupais.
seasonNote: All year — Tuesdays and Saturdays fill first

name: Mata Ki Chowki
description: An evening of Devi bhajans around the decorated chowki — the Navratri favourite that families book all year for manautis.
inclusions: Devi bhajans and jagran set — 3–4 hrs

name: Shyam Darbaar
description: An overnight darbaar of Khatu Shyam bhajans — kirtan through the night, the way the festival-season sankirtans are held.
inclusions: Overnight kirtan — dusk to early morning
Shyam dhwaja and darbaar setup guidance

name: Ram Darbaar
description: Ram bhajans and Ramcharitmanas chaupais sung before the Ram Darbaar — for griha pravesh, birthdays and thanksgiving gatherings.
inclusions: Ram bhajan and chaupai set — 2–3 hrs

name: Shiva Stotra Satsang
description: A scheduled satsang of Shiva stotras — Rudrashtakam, Shiv Tandav and Lingashtakam sung with the meanings explained between them.

name: Generic Mix
description: A flexible devotional set built around your occasion — bhajans across deities, chosen with you on the confirmation call.
inclusions: Set list agreed on the confirmation call
